mapper.select: SELECT a.no,course_no,title,thumbnail,m.name as instructor,pay_price,regular_price FROM course_cart a JOIN course c ON a.course_no=c.no JOIN member m ON c.instructor_no=m.member_id WHERE a.member_id=#{member_id} ORDER BY a.regdate DESC OFFSET #{start} ROWS FETCH NEXT 3 ROWS ONLY
SELECT bod.no, bod.book_order_no, bod.book_no, bod.quantity, bod.price, b.title, b.poster FROM book_order_detail bod JOIN book b ON b.no = bod.book_no WHERE bod.book_order_no = #{book_order_no}
